|errata_history=This is the Players Committee's errata card image marked "E" (Holotable image set). The Light Side text is the same as [[Corellia (PC Errata 2)]]; the Dark Side text differs ("Each of your starships are hyperspeed +1 …" here, "Your starships are hyperspeed +1 …" on the later image, marked D-E1, as on the printed card). The High-Res Scan is strangewayes' print-ready copy of this errata card (HiRez project), which has the same wording.
